correctness.rationale: Direct expansion of the displayed polynomial gives nine distinct monomials with total coefficient 12. The standard snake-graph principal-coefficient formula expresses the F-polynomial as one height monomial per perfect matching, so evaluation at all coefficient variables equal to one counts matchings. Thus the two target assertions cannot both hold.
